[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser was good, but didn't stand out from other cleansers I've used. This wasn't stripping or irritating. I do wish this came in opaque packaging to protect the vitamin C.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a fan of CeraVe, and I really wanted to like this product. I like that there is a pump which makes the cleanser easy to use. Unfortunately, the Brightening Vitamin C Facial Cleanser did not work for me. It has an unpleasant scent. Almost like herbs that have gone bad. It you use a mineral sunscreen, this cleanser will not be strong enough to clean your face. There is a good foam, but not great at removing all impurities. I mostly use it in the mornings now instead of the end of the day when my face is oilier. Overall, this product was not for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I loved the CeraVe Brightening facial Cleaner. It instantly brightened my skin by removing some of the tanning. It made my skin more firm and visibly hydrated. I was surprised that it was more refreshing then my fear of dryness.

I was very happy with the cerave cleanser. It made my sking appear more brighter and more hydrated. It made the dullness dissapear after the firm wash and also made my skin feel more firm. I never felt a face wash feeling so refreshing even after the first use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Developed with dermatologists, this brightening vitamin c cleanser gently exfoliates to leave your face clean and ready for the day. It has little to no scent, just the smell of clean. Doesn't make my face feel dried out after using. Good stuff.

avis.titre: Love it for my dry skin
avis.texte: I will keep using it! I usually look for sensitive skin products, and generally like CeraVe for that reason. This is gentle and smells good (chocolatey almost?) and is creamy but lathers nicely. I can use it daily and don't experience irritation while feeling like I'm being woken up a little extra.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this cleanser for about a month and honestly say that I look forward to washing my face with it every morning. It is a light and refreshing cleanser. I don't have any irritation from it and I feel like my skin is brighter and more radiant before applying makeup.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin soft and clean
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to receive and try this Cerave brightening vitamin c facial cleanser. I love Cerave products and I was looking forward to trying their cleanser. I was actually in the market for a new cleanser because the one I was previously using was not doing it for me. After trying the Cerave facial cleanser, I am officially hooked! It makes my skin clean without leaving it feeling dry and it definitely works to clean my skin. It has not caused me to have any breakouts which is a plus. I use it everyday and I will continue to use it! Highly recommend if you're in the market for a new cleanser.

avis.titre: Vitamin C cleanser for sensitive skin
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] CeraVe is my favorite trusted brand for my sensitive skin. I've been using their vitamin C serum for several years. My skin tone looks more evenly. Couple small dark spots on my cheeks have a little less noticeable after almost a month of using. This cleanser creates a great combo with their vitamin C Serum for maximizing better results. No breakout at all. My skin feels cleaned and soft.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have sensitive skin, so I normally oil cleanse. This facial cleaner was a really nice mix in that didn't make my rosaceae flare up and left my face feeling clean but not dry. It's very nice for the days I need a little extra oomph in my routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser was tested on both my sensitive dry skin and my partners oily skin. We felt like this cleanser was better for oily skin as it left a nice glow and lessened oil productions and left his face feeling fresh. For me it worked nicely under the cerave moisturizer but did not provide lasting hydration. Overall best for oily skin if you want a nice cleanser that creates glowy skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an amazing product. It is good for sensitive skin, and it does not have any scent. An added bonus is that it is helping to fade my dark spots, something I have never had a cleanser do! Also love the pump packaging which is great. Cerave has amazing products within a good price point. I definitely will be purchasing once this is finished.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A must have in the shower for my facial cleaning routine. Light and easy to use. Face feels clean afterwards with no weird film or drying effect. Foams up nicely with a scrubber. Has lasted 2 months and I'm maybe halfway through the bottle.

avis.titre: bright clean lather with a slightly unpleasant smell
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It is nice and thick and lathers nicely. It is completely clear and has a refreshing feel. The only thing that was a downside for me was the scent. It has a mild, yet chemical smell. It did not smell bad, but it was not enjoyable and I find myself not wanting to reach for it as much because of that.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love CervaVe products and this one did not disappoint. This product left my skin feeling clean without overly drying my skin. It lathers well and does not have any odor. I feel like it is too early to tell if it actually brightened my skin or helped with discoloration but I will definitely continue using it in my daily routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Removes makeup perfectly. It's gentle to the face and leaves skin feeling soft and not dry. Doesnt have a strong smell as I'm sensitive to smells. Products rate as good with quality ingredients.

avis.titre: Very good cleanser, nice lather and helps even out skin.
avis.texte: After using it for a few months I've noticed my skin is more even and brighter. I do not care for the smell too much though!
This cleanser left my skin flawless, giving glowy look, bright and healthy, my skin absorbs it, and it does not leave any residue, it feels very light and my skin feels fresh all day.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very pleased with this Brightening vitamin c facial cleanser from Cerave. It does a great job at making my skin clean and clear with no rough feels. Great scent and texture. Highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: Amazing! After consistent use it evens skin tone
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The CeraVe brightening cleanser does exactly what it says. It leaves your skin feeling clean, fresh, and after repeated and consistent use it evens out skin blemishes and uneven tones and promotes healthier skin all around. It smells really good and it lathers so nice! Highly recommend if you're looking for add this to your facial care routine!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This brightening vitamin c facial cleaner comes in a large bottle that lasts a while! It is unscented and great for sensitive skin. It lathers well and rinses off easily, no weird after feel. After using it, I won't say it "brightens" your skin, but it does make it feel less dull overall. It is a good value for the product.

avis.titre: Works well for evening out skin tone
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser was interesting to use. It works subtly, rather than quickly. The first time I used it, I did notice a small amount of tingling afterwards, but not with subsequent uses. I noticed that my skin tone looked more even over time. The cleanser didn't really build much of a lather for me, so it was a little tricky to be sure I'd washed it all off. It was also more runny than I would generally expect for a cleanser, but that actually made it easier to dispense. Overall, I couldn't say if my skin looked brighter, since I didn't notice a difference with that, but my skin tone did look nicer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this cleanser. It foams up nicely and leaves my skin feeling clean. My skin is on the sensitive side and this hits the sweet spot where I get some exfoliation and brightening without it being too harsh on my skin. I use this as my night time cleanser. It cleans my makeup off and my skin gets some down time before any sun exposure. Using it twice a day would be too much for my skin.

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed
avis.texte: I really liked this cleanser. It cleaned my skin well without leaving it feeling tight or dry, and after using it for a while my skin looked more refreshed and glowy.

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser that leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed
avis.texte: I really liked this cleanser. It cleaned my skin well without leaving it feeling tight or dry, and after using it for a while my skin looked more refreshed and glowy.

This facial cleaner was a really nice mix in that didn't make my rosaceae flare up and left my face feeling clean but not dry. It's very nice for the days I need a little extra oomph in my routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was worried that it would be harsh for my skin but it's not! I like that it doesn't have a scent but I'm curious how it will do with my sensitive skin long term. So far, I like the cleanser

avis.titre: Leaves skin feeling fresh and clean
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. As someone with very dry, sensitive skin, I have to be careful what products I use. I had good luck with Cerave products in the past, and using it this time was no different. The bottle is a good size and lasts a long time. I've been using it for over a month and still have between half and 3/4 of the bottle left. It foams up nicely when you use it and definitely gives you a nice, clean feeling after. It doesn't leave any heavy/oily residue. It didn't bother my dry/sensitive skin, which was great because so many products do. I think this would be good for all skin types. Another winner. Highly recommend!
